mechanism_narrative: A rising FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% in the month prior to the prediction horizon is associated with tighter financial conditions, which reduces equity discounting and drives negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >70% of FEDFUNDS > 4.5 events, or FEDFUNDS decline is not statistically significant against SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) of at least 2% over the prior quarter is associated with stronger consumer demand, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically outperforming the prior quarter's average (p > 0.05), or PAYEMS growth < 2% in all tested quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (goods demand) and HOUST (housing starts) above their prior month's levels is a leading indicator of resilient economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies are above trend, or the joint signal is not predictive in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) by more than 5% from the prior month suggests supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines are not predictive of negative returns (p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a baseline in 3 out of 4 contraction regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% suggests disinflation, which reduces equity discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than average inflation-neutral benchmarks (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL fails to stay below 2 for the required window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE (unemployment) below 3.5% signals tight labor markets, which can drive positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE crosses below 3.5% (p > 0.05), or the effect is not robust across multiple tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: When both RSAFS (retail sales) and PAYEMS (employment) show simultaneous monthly increases above 5%, it indicates resilient consumer and labor markets, predicting positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed thresholds, or interaction is not significant in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in GDPC1 (goods demand) of 10% or more over two consecutive quarters is a supply shock proxy, associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not consistently negative during such contractions (p > 0.05), or the effect is not detectable in the presence of confounding inflation data.
